title: Lifshitz-like Magnetic Black Branes: Third Law of Thermodynamics and the Null Energy Condition
summary: We develop a procedure to solve Einstein-dilaton-Maxwell models in quadratures using the potential reconstruction approach. We then apply this procedure to three distinct models, examining both the null energy condition (NEC) and the validity of the third law of thermodynamics in each case. The explicit knowledge of the blackening function -- as opposed to relying solely on numerical data -- allows us to discuss the validity of the third law in detail.
